top_signals.title: Drones are changing warfare. But defense giants are still making billions from old-school weapons
top_signals.summary: The world's biggest defense firms are finding that demand for traditional military equipment remains strong even as drones and AI reshape how wars are fought.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Inside the card-grading empire shaping the price of Pokémon cards
top_signals.summary: PSA’s resale premium, backlog and grading-market dominance shape what collectors pay — and how much their Pokémon cards may fetch.
